title: DeBank Portfolio Snapshot Status Mix
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=debank:portfolio
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(snapshot_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the DeBank portfolio snapshot feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `snapshot_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It always the overall mood of your DeBank portfolio snapshot feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
